scope: Timed generation and human aesthetic-rating infrastructure; not a new source-first physics calibration.
time_notice_delivery: Once per threshold, at the next exchange if generation continues; cannot interrupt an in-flight response.
deadline_enforcement: Discard edits completed after deadline; retain prior completed files
Interrupted provider token usage explicitly unknown

browser_smoke.scope: Temporary offline cohort only; saves 4/5 then 2/5, reloads, preserves both revisions, verifies artifact bytes, desktop/mobile screenshots, no page errors.

manual_review.storage: Git-ignored reviews/aesthetics/*.jsonl; append-only revisions; export JSON from UI
manual_review.identity: Full frozen submission file hashes, task version, reviewer, timestamp, camera mode
manual_review.isolation: Trusted reviewer on a separate loopback origin from read-only simulator artifacts

limitations: Five source-first physics graders remain specifications, not runnable/calibrated checks.
Four-minute difficulty is estimated from two older mechanical-task runs, not yet a revised-task cohort.
Human aesthetics is a separate ordinal score; no automatic conversion into task pass/fail.
